full-ai-cluster/nixos/modules/k3s-join-intent-preflight.sh — the sibling of k3s-datastore-preflight.sh above, admitted for the same structural reason and covering the case that one explicitly does not. It is a systemd oneshot ordered `before` k3s.service and `requiredBy` it, so no stage-0 shell script can be its parent: routing it behind an existing door would mean running it after the thing it exists to gate.
